# Municipal Ordinance No. KAP711, Series of 1998

**Kapasiyahan Blg. 711**

## Summary

Resolution (Kapasiyahan) No. 711, Series of [[1998]], enacted by the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] of [[Municipality of Pitogo|Pitogo]], Quezon on June 22, 1998. This resolution grants a certificate of recognition and appreciation (pagkilala at pagpapahalaga) to Mayor Rafael C. Glinoga for his long and meritorious service as Municipal Secretary (Kalihim Pambayan) and Municipal Mayor of Pitogo.

## Key Provisions

- **WHEREAS:** Mayor [[Rafael C. Glinoga]] served as Municipal Secretary (Kalihim Pambayan) starting January 1, 1968 until April 22, 1976, and as Officer-in-Charge from April 17, 1986 to December 10, 1987.
- **WHEREAS:** He was elected and served as Municipal Mayor (Punong Bayan) starting February 1, 1988, and his term expires on June 30, 1998.
- **WHEREAS:** Due to his outstanding and singular dedication, he earned the respect and love of the community he served.
- **RESOLVED:** On motion by Konsehal Ramon M. Glinoga and seconded by Konsehal Timoteo F. Villaflor, Jr., the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] grants formal recognition and appreciation to Mayor [[Rafael C. Glinoga]] for his long and faithful service as Municipal Secretary and Municipal Mayor.
- **RESOLVED FURTHER:** A copy of this resolution shall be furnished to Mayor [[Rafael C. Glinoga]] for his information.

## Entities

- [[Sangguniang Bayan]] — enacted the resolution
- [[Municipality of Pitogo]] — local government unit
- [[Rafael C. Glinoga]] — Municipal Mayor (honoree)
- [[Rodante V. Cortes]] — Vice Mayor / Presiding Officer (Pangandalawang Punong Bayan)
- [[Socrates B. Boruel]] — Secretary to the Sangguniang Bayan
- [[Ramon M. Glinoga]] — Konsehal, moved the resolution
- [[Timoteo F. Villaflor Jr.]] — Konsehal, seconded the resolution
